task: rtl/async_fifo.sv is a depth-8 dual-clock FIFO with gray-coded pointers crossing domains through synchronisers. It must work for any ratio between the write and read clocks. Make it signoff-ready (3 ns write clock). Keep the port list. tb/tb_smoke_afifo.sv is the block's smoke test.

actions.rationale: Lint the async FIFO RTL first to catch style, width, and obvious logic issues before any simulation or synthesis.
Compile the design together with the smoke testbench to verify syntax, port connectivity, and elaboration before running it.
Run the smoke test to check functional behavior (write/read across the two clock domains) before attempting timing closure.
